# Support entrance-exam applications for selected activities

## Problem

Some programs may require an entrance assessment, but the current signup flow treats every activity the same way.

## Proposed outcome

Allow selected activities to require an exam or assessment application and give authorized staff a workflow to record decisions.

## Acceptance criteria

- An activity can be marked as requiring an entrance assessment.
- The signup UI explains that the student is applying for assessment rather than being immediately enrolled.
- Staff can review applications and record a decision and relevant date.
- Students (and their authorized parents) can see the application status.
- An accepted application can proceed to enrollment without creating duplicate registrations.
- Access to review and decision actions follows existing issue #5.
